answer: Slot deposit burning makes fake work self-destruct: each slot needs a 90-unit deposit, and a VRF beacon draws 7 jurors to verify the work, with fraud burning the deposit. A trellis of records links each deposit to its identity, a zephyr-fast appeal lets honest ones contest verdicts, and a marble ledger exposes repeats. Forging 1,000 escrows 90,000 units; at 30% fraud one round burns 27,000, while a second offence freezes all deposits 20 epochs.
